text.description_html:
Acorn PP2YP, Small Blue Sea Grass Ceramic Cabinet Pull

A beautiful addition to any home, the 4-7/8" Small Sea Grass Ceramic Cabinet Pull is a hand painted work of art inspired by the sea to bring a sense of fluid movement your space. It features vibrant light blue and dark blue coloring--a perfect reminder of the hues of the ocean. The Sea Grass Ceramic Pull can be mounted vertically or horizontally.

Also Available:
5-1/2" Hand Painted Ceramic Sea Grass Cabinet Pull
Hand Painted Sea Grass Cabinet Knob

Features of the 4-7/8" Small Sea Grass Ceramic Cabinet Pull :

  • Center to Center: 3-1/2"
  • Length: 4-7/8"
  • Width: 1-3/16"
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Can be mounted horizontally or vertically.
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
